$comment: Subject -> its schema history (registered IN THIS ORDER), compatibility level and fixtures directory. tools/schema-check registers every version in order under the level, so the whole history is checked, not only the last pair. FULL_TRANSITIVE: producers and consumers deploy independently and replays read old data with new code, so only fields WITH defaults may be added or removed. fixtures: <dir>/incompatible/*.avsc must be rejected and <dir>/compatible/*.avsc accepted on top of the history.
